caption: The drawing features a detailed depiction of a brown leather satchel with two wide straps extending upwards, likely for attachment to a belt or harness. The satchel has several compartments and pockets of varying sizes, with visible stitching and carefully rendered seams. The upper section of the satchel includes three buckled leather straps that secure the flap, and there are inner dividers visible between the flaps. The lower portion of the satchel consists of a netted or chainmail-like pouch that is colored in shades of gray and brown, and it hangs loosely from the leather section above. The overall color palette is naturalistic, primarily browns for the leather and a metallic gray-brown for the netting, set against a plain, unadorned light beige background. There is minimal shadowing, and the composition is centered with the entire object clearly visible.
title: Physicians's Saddle Bag
